children: Overview
Switzerland real estate investor's H1 net rental income grew 5.1% yr/yr, vacancy rate declined
Group Adjusted EBITDA for H1 rose 25% yr/yr; Funds from Operations declined slightly
Company reduced Loan-to-Value Ratio to 45.2% and confirmed 2026 guidance
Outlook
Company confirms 2026 guidance for like-for-like net rental income to rise by around 6.0%
Peach Property Group sees 2026 Group FFO between EUR 17 mln and EUR 19 mln
Company maintains medium-term target to reduce Loan-to-Value Ratio to below 45%
Result Drivers
RELETTING AND RECEIVABLES MANAGEMENT - Co said faster reletting, more active receivables management and targeted portfolio investments supported higher net rental income and lower vacancy rate
